summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by WPP plc (a UK foreign private issuer) announcing the appointment of Peter Agnefjall to its board of directors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a standard regulatory update for a board appointment, which does not constitute a forced or abrupt management change. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
